_about: THERO-ROAR: per-species numbers for tools/gait/make_thero_roar.py (the shared rearing roar). Angles in degrees, rise/back in hip heights. secs: clip length; rear_pitch: body nose-up on the hips; chest_pitch: spread over Spine1..Chest; neck_pitch: Neck1 up (Neck2 takes back 0.4 of it); head_up: the head thrown up at the start and end of the sweep; dip: how far the neck dips forward in the middle of the sweep; sweep: the snout heading's total yaw sweep; jaw: the roar's gape (each species' tested alert maximum); tail_hold: fraction of the rear the tail root takes back (the rest droops: the counterweight); tail_swing: tail yaw against the head; arms: raise, spread (outward), flex (elbow), curl (hand). Every number an ASSUMPTION, tuned on the review renders.
